Faq.title: FAQ
Faq.subtitle: Common questions about Nawasul.
Faq.q1: How does the QR sticker work?
Faq.a1: Each vehicle gets a unique QR code printed on a weather-resistant sticker. When someone scans it, Nawasul sends you a push notification and initiates an automated call — without ever revealing your phone number to the scanner.
Faq.q2: Will my phone number be visible to the person who scans my QR?
Faq.a2: No. Your phone number is never shown to the person scanning your QR code. All communication is routed through Nawasul's secure notification system.
Faq.q3: How do I order a replacement sticker?
Faq.a3: Go to your vehicle details, tap Order Sticker, and follow the checkout flow. Replacement stickers are shipped to your registered address within 3–5 business days.
Faq.q4: What happens if I don't answer the notification call?
Faq.a4: If you miss the automated call, you'll still receive a push notification and SMS alert with details about the scan. You can view the full alert in the Alerts tab.
Faq.q5: Can I register more than one vehicle?
Faq.a5: Yes. Depending on your subscription plan, you can register multiple vehicles. Each vehicle gets its own QR code and can be managed independently from the Vehicles tab.
Faq.q6: How do I update my contact information?
Faq.a6: Go to Account → Edit Profile to update your name and city. Phone number changes require OTP re-verification for security — contact support if you need to change your number.
Faq.a7: Nawasul offers Free, Pro, and Premium plans with monthly or annual billing. Visit Account → Subscription Plans in the app to compare features and upgrade.
Faq.a8: Yes. All personal data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We comply with Saudi data protection regulations and never share your information with third parties without your consent.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.p1: This Privacy Policy describes how Nawasul Group (“we”, “us”) collects, uses, and protects information when you use our websites and products, including Nawasul.
Privacy.p2: We collect information you provide (such as contact details and vehicle information) and technical data needed to operate our services securely.
Privacy.p3: We use data to provide notifications, improve products, communicate with you, and meet legal obligations. We do not sell personal data.
Privacy.p4: QR scanners never receive an owner’s phone number. Notification routing is designed to protect owner privacy.
